question: For which famous English novel did Sunetra Gupta receive the Sahitya Akademi Award in 1996?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Memories of Rain**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sunetra Gupta’s debut novel **‘Memories of Rain’ gets the Sahitya Academy Award for the year 1996.**
 
• It has been started on a rainy Friday when Moni is walking down **Oxford Street in the afternoon Moni.**
 
• She has been married to Antony for Ten Years and has a six-year-old daughter.
 
• **It certainly opens the gates of remembrance.**
 
• **The novel is mainly about three characters- Moni, Anthony and Anna.**
 
• It is an astounding debut novel by the novelist as it is a kind of contemplation on the **East-West split through the account of the marriage of a gorgeous-looking Indian girl with an average Englishman.**
 
• **The novelist has used the flashback technique or we can say stream of consciousness technique in this novel in order to bring the past to the surface.**
 
• **This technique has been effectively used here by the novelist.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **About Sahitya Akademi:**

 
 
• The **Sahitya Akademi is India's National Academy of Letters, established on March 12, 1954.**
 
• It is an** organization dedicated to the promotion of literature in the languages of India.**
 
• It has** recognized 24 languages as major languages, including English.**
 
• The Akademi conducts literary programs and publishes books in all **24 languages.**
 
• It also translates literary works from one Indian language into others to promote a multilingual and inclusive literary environment.
 
• It is the highest literary honor in India, and it confers awards for outstanding works of literary merit.
 
• **The most prestigious of these is the Sahitya Akademi Award, given annually since 1954.**
 
• The **Sahitya Akademi Award** consists of a casket containing an engraved copper plaque, a shawl, and a cash prize.
 
• It functions as an autonomous organization funded by, but operating independently of, the Indian government.
